en.rp_src_ema: EMA, CPMP/EWP/4151/00 Rev. 2, Section 5.1: 90% confidence interval, 0.85–1.18. The three computations (pooled, batch means, mixed model) were chosen by KK-27; (a) and (b) are published implementations (Chen et al. 2019; Kurumaddali et al. 2019), (c) rests on the pooling rule of Thompson (1962).
en.rp_src_sim: Morris, White and Crowther 2019, Statistics in Medicine (ADEMP; Monte Carlo standard error). The KK-38 label and the KK-39 threshold rule are by design.
en.rp_validation_tek: The simulation engine and the exported script are validated in FSR-VAL-SIM-1 v1.1 (KK-53). Classes, metric names and labels are produced in R (FSR-TN-PLT-02); the screen and the report use the same formatting rule (P4-K3, P5-K1).
en.rp_validation_tasarim: The simulation engine is validated in FSR-VAL-SIM-1 v1.1 (KK-53). The selection rules are in FSR-TN-PBE-01 v0.11 Section 11.5 (Tables 11.3a and 11.3b); the platform reproduces these tables (FSR-TN-PLT-05, D-1). The selection is limited to the candidate set.

en.an_subtitle: Validated models on your own data: FDA PBE, EMA 90% CI, MSD, Weibull MSD, f2 and bootstrap f2
en.an_privacy: Your data never leave the browser; the computation runs in R inside the browser (webR).
en.an_pbe_cols: Columns: batch, container, stage, product, score (or parti, kap, asama, urun, olcum). Separator ; , or tab; a decimal comma is accepted.
en.an_dis_cols: Wide layout: first column Time, others <product>.<unit> (Test.1, …, Ref.1, …), one row per time point. The long layout also works: Product, Unit, Time, Diss. Reference lots are given as separate product names (e.g. STD1.1).

en.an_note_msd: Multivariate statistical distance with Hotelling's T² (Tsong et al. 1996); L2a/L2b need at least 2 reference lots.
en.an_note_weibull: MSD on Weibull parameters (Sathe et al. 1996); B-L2a needs at least 2 reference lots.

en.rp_validation_dis: The f2/bootstrap f2, MSD and Weibull MSD cores and the v0.5.1 bridge are inherited validated models (FSR-LOG-01 G-01; pinned with SHA-256). Platform validation: FSR-VAL-PLT-1. Research and education only; not a system validated for GxP environments.

en.an_ema_hint: EMA: is the 90% CI of the ratio of geometric means within 0.85–1.18? Balanced designs only (same number of containers in every batch). Three computation paths are shown; the decision is that of path (b). There is no one-sided test in EMA.
en.an_ema_pass: EMA criterion met: the 90% CI of path (b) lies within 0.85–1.18
en.an_ema_fail: EMA criterion not met: the 90% CI of path (b) extends beyond 0.85–1.18
en.an_ema_none: No decision: path (b) could not be computed
en.an_ema_label: The three paths are candidate implementations (KK-27): the guideline does not define how the 90% CI is computed with batches and life stages; (a) and (b) are published implementations (Chen et al. 2019; Kurumaddali et al. 2019), (c) rests on the pooling rule of Thompson (1962). The decision line is path (b) (FSR-TN-PLT-08 E-K3). Life stages (B/M/E) are combined in the unit mean.
en.rp_data_table_note: As used in the analysis, with the values as read (full precision).
en.rp_data_omitted: The data table was not added to the report (the “Add the data to the report” box on the screen was not ticked). That the same file was used can be checked with the SHA-256 fingerprint.
en.rp_data_large: The data have more than {n} rows, so the table was not added to the report; the SHA-256 fingerprint identifies the file.
en.an_with_data: Add the data to the report
en.rp_validation_ema: The computation uses the validated functions of the simulation engine (invitro_array, ema_ci_fast; FSR-VAL-SIM-1 v1.1, TC-F3, TC-F4, TC-F11; pinned with SHA-256). Input checks are those of the PBE bridge (pbe_kopru.R). Platform validation: FSR-VAL-PLT-1. For research and education; not a system validated for GxP environments.
en.rp_src_ema_1: EMA, CPMP/EWP/4151/00 Rev. 2 (2025), Section 5.1 criterion 8: 90% CI of the ratio of geometric means within 85–118 (log-normal); at least three batches, at least ten units per batch
en.rp_src_ema_2: (a): Chen et al. (2019) Method 3, Kurumaddali et al. (2019); (b): Chen et al. (2019) Method 4; (c): Thompson (1962), REML closed form Searle, Casella & McCulloch (2006); combined degrees of freedom Satterthwaite (1946)
en.rp_src_ema_3: (b): in the Stage 1 simulation the type I error of (b) and (c) is ≤ 5% in all designs (FSR-TN-PBE-01 Section 11.7); (b) is the simpler one (FSR-TN-PLT-08 E-K3)
